wasAutoSkipped.description: True if max snooze count was reached and status was auto-set to SKIP

daysOfWeek.description: Only for WEEKLY schedule. Must be null/omitted for other schedule types.

intervalDays.description: Only for INTERVAL schedule. Must be null/omitted for other schedule types.

cycleOnDays.description: Only for CYCLE schedule. Must be null/omitted for other schedule types.

times.description: Optional. If provided, all existing times for this regimen will be replaced with the new times. TimeIds will be regenerated.

provider.description: Use 'email' or 'google'. If a user has both, the stored value will be 'email,google'. Legacy input 'both' is still accepted.

allowMerge.description: Legacy flag (accepted but no longer required)
